blocks.text: The proposed model reaches 92 percent accuracy on the benchmark. Accuracy improves steadily as the number of rounds increases. Compared with the baseline the accuracy gain is consistent across seeds. Training cost grows linearly with the number of participating clients. Each round requires about ten minutes of GPU time per client. We therefore report cost in total GPU hours for every setting. Privacy is preserved because raw data never leaves the client device. Only encrypted gradient updates are sent to the server. We leave a formal privacy analysis for future work.
